BOOK CARDS: Harbor Secret is an illustrated mystery story with eighty pages. Animals Nearby is a factual guide with one hundred and twenty pages, maps, and animal photographs. Beyond the Clouds is a ninety-page factual space guide with no pictures. All three are available from the library.

READER NOTES: Jo wants fiction under one hundred pages with pictures. Ren wants factual information about local animals and does not mind a longer book. Lin wants a factual book under one hundred pages and is comfortable reading without illustrations.

GROUP REQUEST: The three first hope to borrow one title that satisfies all their needs. Their teacher asks them to compare the cards before assuming such a title exists. They may instead borrow separate books and share one interesting idea at next week's reading circle.

Jo selects Harbor Secret, Ren chooses Animals Nearby, and Lin takes Beyond the Clouds. Each writes which features supported the choice. A book can suit one reader without meeting another reader's current purpose, so the group does not label the unchosen titles bad.
